Twist: The classic, lightweight bottle. Great for everyday use, handwash only (unless it says “Made in Austria”), and you refill by removing the mouthpiece. Perfect for still water lovers!
Twist Pro: The upgraded version! Dishwasher-safe, easier to refill (thanks to a detachable adapter), and has a fancy mouthpiece that activates pods automatically. Works with still and sparkling water. More leak-resistant too!
Twist Pro Steel: Just like Twist Pro, but made of stainless steel to keep your water cool for longer. Premium feel!
Click: Quick to open with a click lid, designed for still water only. Simple and speedy!
Tumbler: Stylish cup with a straw, fits most car cupholders, ideal for sipping on the go.

Here’s how to use your air up® Twist bottle for the very first time:

Rinse all parts with lukewarm water and mild dish soap 🧼.
Insert the straw into the mouthpiece until it reaches the marked line (tip pointing down).
Attach the mouthpiece (with straw) to the bottle body.
Place your pod on the mouthpiece, sticker facing up. Pull the pod up until you feel resistance—this activates the scent!
Close the lid securely to make it leak-proof.
Attach the strap if you want to carry it easily.
Fill with plain water, sip upright, and listen for bubbles—that means it’s working! 😋
